items.title: PACE：用于快速VLM推理的统一压缩与提取范式
items.originalTitle: PACE: A Unified Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Fast VLM Inference
items.summary: 视觉语言模型推理成本随视觉标记增加而上升。PACE提出无训练框架，通过自适应像素压缩器在编码前评估信息密度并下采样冗余，动态双注意力提取器融合视觉与语义信号保留关键标记。集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B后，用10%的视觉标记保留93.8%性能，TTFT加速3.1倍。
items.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate exceptional visual reasoning capabilities, yet their inference costs escalate rapidly with the proliferation of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods exhibit two fundamental limitations. First, most approaches operate exclusively post-vision encoder, leaving the substantial latency of the visual encoding phase unoptimized. Second, under strict token budgets, these methods often fail to jointly preserve holistic visual contexts and fine-grained details, leadi…
keyFacts: 如何同时优化视觉编码器和LLM阶段的推理延迟并保持视觉上下文与细节？
提出PACE框架，包含自适应像素压缩器（APC）和动态双注意力提取器（DDAE），在编码前压缩冗余输入并选择性保留视觉标记。

keyFacts: 如何在单一信任域下同时满足角色自由漂移、执行可追踪和解耦？
提出角色-执行分离（PES）架构模式，角色与执行分离在不同信任域，通过合同桥、审批矩阵、DLP和审计连接。

Concretely, we formulate the re…

items.summary: 本研究训练了六个线性探针，对应道德基础理论的六个类别（关怀/伤害、公平/欺骗、自由/压迫、忠诚/背叛、权威/颠覆、神圣/堕落），检查它们在表示空间中的方向关系。发现这些方向既未坍缩为单一道德检测器，也未相互隔离，而是共享正公共成分的同时跨越近最大数量的独立维度。该几何结构在不同架构和规模中一致，并在预训练早期达到整合状态。未发现个体化/约束性区分，而是反映语料库统计。在道德困境中，每个困境方向部分由基础成分组成，强度为不匹配基线的2.7倍，而大部分方差编码冲突特有结构。

items.summary: 我们提出CAST（概念引导伪影抑制调整），一个基于SAE的临床文本分类框架。它使用稀疏自编码器从中间Transformer激活中提取可审计特征，通过LLM辅助解释和ICD-10检索约束标记潜在特征，在微调时通过残差减法抑制已验证的伪影特征，并提供逐概念归因以审计模型决策。在MIMIC-IV出院记录死亡预测上，CAST优于相应的微调编码器基线，并与强LLM基线竞争，同时产生特征级审计轨迹。
items.abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretatio…
keyFacts: 如何使临床语言模型在分布偏移下保持稳健并支持可审计的决策？
使用稀疏自编码器暴露中间激活的可审计特征，用LLM辅助解释和ICD-10约束标记，通过残差减法抑制伪影特征，并在微调后提供逐概念归因。
在MIMIC-IV死亡预测上，CAST优于微调编码器基线，与强LLM基线竞争，并提供特征级审计轨迹，展示支持预测的临床概念和训练期间抑制的伪影概念。

items.title: CorporateBench：基于时间知识库的大规模问答基准
items.originalTitle: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases
items.summary: 我们提出CorporateBench（CB），一个人类验证的多任务问答基准，规模接近LLM在企业通信网络中遇到的条件，评估语料超过230,000个文档。CB通过四个合成公司（员工数从12到10,000）评估LLM在信息提取和知识库查询两个维度上的表现。每个语料库从时间演化的知识库中采样，确保跨文档逻辑一致性。对五个LLM的评估显示，随着输入规模接近现实规模，性能下降明显。
items.abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowl…
keyFacts: 如何构建一个大规模、人类验证的问答基准来评估LLM在企业级文档集上的推理能力？
通过合成生成四家公司（员工数12至10,000）的语料库，每个语料库从时间演变的知识库采样以保证逻辑一致性，并包含信息提取和知识库查询任务；评估五个LLM。
CB包含超过230,000个文档的评估语料；五个LLM在CB上的性能随输入规模增大而下降，揭示了现实规模下的性能瓶颈。

items.summary: 生成式AI改变信息获取方式，挑战传统广告机制。我们提出潜在广告商混合拍卖（LAMA），一种令牌级广告机制，将广告商影响嵌入生成过程。广告商报告局部延续值，诱导特定于广告商的下一令牌策略，平台通过潜在混合解码同时更新分配后验。我们证明LAMA满足马尔可夫DSIC和IR，并接近最优KL正则化福利。实验结果初步表明生成原生广告的可行性。
items.abstract: Generative AI is transforming how people access information, challenging traditional advertising mechanisms built around predefined slots. Towards generation-native advertising, we propose the Latent Advertiser Mixture Auction (LAMA), a token-level advertising mechanism that embeds advertiser influence directly into the generation process. Advertisers report local continuation values that induce advertiser-specific next-token policies, from which the platform decodes through a latent mixture while updating an allo…
keyFacts: 如何设计生成原生的令牌级广告机制，使广告商影响嵌入生成过程并保持激励兼容？
提出潜在广告商混合拍卖（LAMA），广告商报告局部延续值形成特定于广告商的下一令牌策略，平台通过潜在混合解码，并发展基于学习在线重构报告的实现。
LAMA满足马尔可夫DSIC和IR，实现接近最优KL正则化福利；真实商业搜索查询实验显示平台福利和收入提升，同时保持用户响应质量。

items.title: 理解LLM推理的进化策略：比GRPO更广的推理覆盖
items.originalTitle: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
items.summary: 进化策略（ES）作为LLM推理的记忆高效后训练范式出现，但其优化行为研究不足。我们系统研究ES动态和机制，首次从理论和经验上识别ES相对GRPO的性能优势：ES导致更广的推理覆盖，更好利用预训练LLM的推理能力。ES改善Pass@1同时获得更高Pass@K，而GRPO熵崩溃。我们开发顺序GRPO-ES训练策略，结合两者优势。
items.abstract: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reason…
keyFacts: 进化策略在后训练LLM推理中的优化行为是什么？与GRPO相比有何优势？
系统研究ES动态和机制，理论分析验证器投影的Jensen-Shannon多样性与Pass@K关联，实验比较ES与GRPO，并开发顺序GRPO-ES策略。
ES提供更广推理覆盖，改善Pass@1同时更高Pass@K；任务性能提升由稀疏的大幅度更新贡献，不导致灾难性遗忘；较大LLM需要较小种群大小。

items.originalTitle: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit
items.summary: 对LLM评判的审计通过对比匹配条件认证偏差。我们证明双重差分端点未在报告量表上被识别：每项被其自身份额删失，观测统计混淆差异偏好与差异衰减。在预注册审计中，注册主要端点（学习者档案对脚手架偏好的效应）为零（+0.085，p=0.684），但名义显著交互（+0.378，p=0.002）并非偏好识别，由构造含零差异偏好的模型可重现79-85%。
items.abstract: Audits of LLM judges certify a bias by contrasting matched conditions, and the strongest designs difference twice: a within-item contrast between two candidate responses, differenced again across a manipulated attribute, read off a bounded rating scale. We show that this endpoint is not identified on the scale that reports it. Each term of the double difference is censored by its own share, so the observed statistic confounds differential preference with differential attenuation: a severity shift common to both re…
keyFacts: 在有界评分量表上进行双重差分审计时，观测到的交互效应是否可能由删失机制而非真实偏好差异产生？

items.summary: 本文首次将重要性评分指标应用于多头Transformer模型从表格数据中学习的过程，在40个多样化的表格数据集上的实验表明，该评分对注意力头移除具有鲁棒性。在72.5%的实验案例中，模型在逐步移除重要性得分最低的头部时保持最佳性能，而先移除最重要头部则导致分类性能最大下降。此外，重要头部在各层中分散，且重要性在不同表格数据集间差异显著。
items.abstract: Computationally demanding and opaque deep learning models can be better understood and optimized by analyzing how they transform data. While deep transformers have been widely studied in computer vision and natural language processing, their application in tabular data remains relatively underexplored. This paper presents one of the first applications of an importance-scoring metric to interpret multi-head transformer models in learning from tabular data. Experiments conducted on 40 diverse tabular datasets demons…
keyFacts: 如何评估Transformer多头注意力中各个注意力头在表格数据学习中的重要性，并利用该评分优化模型？
提出一种注意力头重要性评分指标，并在40个多样化表格数据集上进行实验，通过逐步移除不同重要性得分的注意力头观察模型性能变化，同时分析各层头部重要性的分布特性。
基于重要性评分逐步移除最低得分头部时，模型在72.5%的实验案例中保持最佳性能；移除最高得分头部则性能下降最显著；重要头部分散在不同层，无一致层间趋势；表格数据集间头部重要性差异大。

items.originalTitle: HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition
items.summary: HALO是一种领域特定的IMU基础模型，通过两阶段训练框架应对感知异质性和开放集活动识别。在10个公共数据集上训练，在7个留出数据集上评估，以约3.5M可训练参数在零样本开放集准确率上比MOMENT提高13.7个百分点，但在严重分布偏移下性能崩溃。
items.abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open…
keyFacts: 如何构建一个统一的IMU基础模型，以处理感知异质性并泛化到未见活动和标签词汇？
两阶段训练：第一阶段使用异质性感知自监督学习预训练IMU编码器，包括自适应池化、通道独立特征提取和上下文传感器条件；第二阶段通过同义词感知软对比学习对齐文本嵌入。

We show that a frozen self-supervised vision-transformer encoder, combined with a lightweight trainable decoder and iterative model-assisted annotation…
keyFacts: 如何高效量化锂离子正极中的颗粒裂纹？
使用冻结的自监督视觉变换器编码器，结合轻量可训练解码器和迭代模型辅助标注。

items.originalTitle: Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics
items.summary: 许多水下模拟器强调视觉真实感而忽视物理保真度。本文提出Stonefish模拟器的物理和传感器接地扩展，增强其水动力学模型，包括随机IMU和DVL漂移、磁力计扰动、高阶水动力学、地面力学、压力驱动的环境变化和基于物理的水下光学。这些添加旨在更好地捕捉深海AUV、ROV等的行为，同时保持实时模拟兼容性，为深海条件下的导航、感知和自主研究提供基础。
items.abstract: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-…
keyFacts: 如何提高深海环境的模拟物理和传感器保真度？

items.summary: 语言模型预训练成本高昂，阻碍学术社区发展。我们提出开放预训练配方，在消费级RTX 5090 GPU上以FP8精度从头训练Puro-2B系列模型，最多1.4万亿token。最佳模型计算成本低于6900美元，接近Qwen2.5-1.5B性能。通过硬件选择、低精度训练、超球优化、课程模型平均和数据配方实现成本效率。我们还推导了Puro成本缩放定律，表明约4400美元即可达到Qwen2-1.5B性能。我们发布完整配方。
items.abstract: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we present an open pretra…
keyFacts: 如何大幅降低语言模型预训练成本并保持性能？
结合硬件选择、低精度训练（FP8）、超球优化、课程模型平均和数据配方的开放配方。
最佳模型成本低于$6.9K，接近Qwen2.5-1.5B性能；成本缩放定律显示$4.4K可达Qwen2-1.5B。

items.summary: 海洋科学依赖MAV收集数据，但手动规划大型舰队复杂耗时。我们提出混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型自动化优化部署，考虑电池容量和时间窗，最大化数据收集并最小化车辆数量和能耗。新颖之处在于集成常规船舶行程，支持中途换电池或加速过境。实验表明模型可扩展，秒级解决数十艘MAV路由，几分钟处理数百艘。该框架还可用于模拟“what-if”场景并提供可视化支持决策。
items.abstract: The marine science community increasingly relies on Marine Autonomous Vehicles (MAVs) to collect the critical environmental data required to understand global ocean systems. However, as these operations scale, manually routing and planning large autonomous fleets becomes exponentially complex and time-consuming. items.summary: 本文介绍一种模块化可重构机器人，结合张拉整体柔顺躯体和爪式连接机构，既能独立操作与移动，也能自重构为链、环、分支等形态，实现协作操作和多模态运动，并展示了协调物体搬运、多模态运动及真实场景中的移动操作能力。
items.abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we in…
keyFacts: 如何将模块化可重构机器人的自重构能力与连续体机器人的柔顺性结合，以实现任务自适应的多机器人协作？
结合张拉整体柔顺躯体和爪式连接机构，使多个机器人可自重构为不同形态（如链、环、分支）进行协作。

items.originalTitle: Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators
items.summary: 本文提出一种基于非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型的实时动态模型任务空间反馈与估计框架，结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器和动态观测器，在三个平面气动软体执行器上验证，实现高精度任务空间控制，精度运动中RMSE为1.5-2.3毫米，高频跟踪为5.5-12.4毫米。
items.abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational effici…
keyFacts: 如何实现气动软体执行器在任务空间的实时高精度闭环控制？
基于绝对坐标和完整约束的非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型，结合准静态前馈逆模型、任务空间PI控制器和动态观测器。
在多种任务中实现1.5-2.3 mm（精度运动）和5.5-12.4 mm（1-2 Hz）的均方根误差，支持跨平台泛化和减少传感条件。

items.summary: 针对机器人拆卸中不规则形状产品的稳定支撑问题，本文提出模块化真空夹具系统，规划一个共享支撑配置用于完整拆卸序列，无需重新配置。使用去噪扩散概率模型生成初始配置，经贝叶斯优化细化，在螺丝刀和剃须刀上验证，平均经验稳定裕度分别为66.9%和81.6%。

As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the comp…

items.abstract: Deterministic source-sink models are widely used to assess the long-term evolution, capacity, and sustainability of the low Earth orbit (LEO) environment. These models propagate shell-averaged populations through ordinary differential equations (ODEs), relying on individual collision, disposal, and decay events to average out within sufficiently large altitude shells. As constellation traffic is increasingly organized into kilometer- and sub-kilometer-scale shells, this averaging assumption becomes strained. We fo…

items.abstract: We study energy-constrained adversarial patrolling on a graph, in which a battery-limited UAV defends a cluster of high-value targets against a strategic attacker who chooses when and where to strike. Our central observation is that the remaining energy is a hidden state: the attacker never observes the battery directly, but observes the patr…

items.summary: MICADO是ELT的首光成像仪，其SCAO系统采用混合控制策略：LQG调节器用于低阶模式以应对振动和风振，积分控制器用于高阶模式。在实验台上验证了该混合控制器，并测试了增加LQG控制模式数量对光学增益鲁棒性的影响，向自主LQG调节器迈进。
items.abstract: The Extremely Large Telecope (ELT) is expected to begin scientific operations in 2030, with MICADO as its first-light imager. The Single Conjugate Adaptive Optics (SCAO) system for MICADO is currently being assembled and tested at the Observatoire de Paris. MICADO's baseline AO control strategy uses a hybrid approach: a Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) regulator for low-order modes, optimised to adapt to the disturbance caused by vibrations and ELT windshake, and an integral action controller for higher-oder modes…
keyFacts: MICADO的SCAO混合LQG+积分控制器在实验台上性能如何？
在MICADO-SCAO实验台上进行实验验证，使用COMPASS模拟平台对比，并增加LQG控制模式数量进行测试。
首次实验验证了混合控制器，增加LQG控制模式数量可提高对光学增益的鲁棒性。

items.title: 银河系非等温垂直分布函数
items.originalTitle: Non-isothermal vertical distribution functions for the Milky Way
items.summary: 传统上假设银河系垂直结构遵循伪等温分布，但巨分子云（GMCs）集中在银道面附近，不会统一随机化垂直相空间。我们提出新的垂直分布函数，包含J_z^{-α}因子。结合二体散射力学，重新审视垂直加热的扩散系数，发现在低相对速度下强烈非线性。求解稳态和含时福克-普朗克方程，发现垂直作用分布偏离伪等温形式，提出广义伪等温分布函数族，非等温性源于GMC分布和库仑对数速度依赖性。
items.abstract: The vertical structure of our Galaxy has commonly been assumed to follow a pseudo-isothermal distribution. However, there is no \textit{a priori} reason to expect this form to arise from scattering by giant molecular clouds (GMCs), since GMCs are confined to a narrow layer around the Galactic midplane and therefore do not randomise stars uniformly in vertical phase space. keyFacts: 银河系垂直结构是否偏离伪等温分布？其非等温性的原因是什么？
利用统计论证推导薄盘GMC极限下的分布函数，结合二体散射力学计算扩散系数，并求解轨道平均福克-普朗克方程。
提出新分布函数族，发现非等温性源于GMC分布和库仑对数的速度依赖性。
